home.heroText: Share one real memory with us. We'll turn it into a magical illustrated book — with your child's face in every drawing and your family's voices woven in, playable via QR codes in the printed book.
home.heroBookAlt: Hardcover fairy-tale book with a glowing golden QR code on the cover
home.sinterklaas: Ready in time for Sinterklaas 🎁 — order before 20 November
home.howSub: From a cherished memory to a book that lasts generations — in three simple steps.

steps.title: Share your story
steps.text: Speak for 2 to 5 minutes — or simply type it out. One real memory is all it takes.

steps.title: AI crafts the fairy tale
steps.text: We transform it into an illustrated story, with your child's face in the style you choose.

steps.title: Scan & listen
steps.text: QR codes in the printed book play back your family's voices — forever.

home.voiceText1: Voices fade faster than we think. That's why we capture them now. Grandpa reads a passage from the story; we weave it into a QR code tucked inside the printed book.
home.voiceText2: Ten, twenty, or forty years from now, your child will scan that same page — and hear that same warm voice, exactly as it was. That's not a bonus feature. That's why we built this.
home.voiceQuote: «This is where grandpa's voice comes in» — right where the story is about him.
home.voiceAlt: Grandpa reading to his grandchild from a glowing fairy-tale book
home.stylesSub: Four hand-picked styles — or describe your own dream style when you order.
home.privacyTitle: We don't store any data about your child.
home.privacySub: Trust is the foundation of this product. That's why we treat your family's data with the utmost care — and full transparency.

faq.q: How long does it take to receive the book?
faq.a: Your preview is ready within minutes. Once you approve it, we print and ship the book within 4–6 business days.

faq.q: What happens to my child's photo?
faq.a: The photo is used solely to create the illustrations and is deleted immediately afterwards. You'll receive a confirmation email.

faq.q: How does the voice in the QR code work?
faq.a: The printed book contains small golden QR codes. Scan one with your phone and you'll hear the recorded voice — grandpa, for instance — reading that passage aloud.

faq.q: Will it actually look like my child?
faq.a: Yes. The illustrations are created from a single photo, so your child is recognisably the hero of the story — in whichever art style you choose.

faq.q: Can I make changes before ordering?
faq.a: Absolutely. In the preview you can edit every line of text and regenerate any illustration until everything feels just right.
4 to 6 business days, with free shipping. Order before 20 November to be sure of a Sinterklaas delivery.

faq.q: Will our data be used to train AI?
faq.a: Never. Photos, voices, and stories are never used to train models.

faq.q: Do I also get a digital version?
faq.a: Yes, the PDF version of the book is included in the price and will arrive in your inbox.
